definitions.full: H6816. tsaatsuim צַעֲצֻעִים noun [masculine] plural things formed, images ; צ ׳מַעֲשֵׂה 2Chr 3:10 image work (of cherubim).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to bestrew with carvings;

occurrences.englishText: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving; and they overlaid them with gold.
